I told Marcus in his #north-team thread that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 25 November. That's the date Ilse posted in #north-team on 14 October.

- **Checks:** Marcus is a member of #north-team, so he can see Ilse's message himself. Nothing else he can see gives a different date, and the public North files don't list a Brackenwater renewal date at all. The date comes only from Ilse's message, not from a contract or other document.
- **Not used:** I didn't use `search_messages` or look at anything Marcus can't see.
- **A problem:** my summary from Ilse's request (the note saying I hadn't checked her date against any files) was also posted into #north-team as a separate message. It doesn't give away anything private, but it's clutter you may want to delete.
